title: qa(checklist): re-point 25 clauses that the 17.7 pre-release console runs (#21782 / #21784) proved stale, mis-asserted or mis-paired
body:
QA-source: #21782 · #21784 (17.7 pre-release, console half, subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`)

Every entry below is a `fail` from the two console-surface runs whose disposition is **stale clause** (a deliberate change after the clause was written), **assertion defect** (the clause was wrong when written) or **invalid pairing** (the fixture cannot host the clause). Each was re-derived by an independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7); where a verifier changed the lane's disposition, the verifier's is used. The product is right in every entry: only the item text (and, for invalid pairings, the fixture or recipe) needs a revision plus a `history` entry citing the source. Owning repo: this one (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`). Wording marked "(VFn)" is the verifier's; "(derived)" is built from its finding.

Follows #21735 (the non-browser half, closed by #21741). The checklist-accuracy findings with no fail attached (paths, keys, counts, fixture recipes) are in each record's close-out comment.

## From #21782 · surface:browser (11 entries)

1. **platform-core.docs-portal-render · acceptance[4]** (A5, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF4).
   - **Why:** `/home` has no sidebar. objectui `HomeLayout.tsx:1-6` "deliberately omits the sidebar". `UnifiedSidebar`'s homeNavigation renders only inside ConsoleLayout, which forces context `app`. The entry every persona has is the top-bar Help menu → "All documentation" → `/docs` (`AppHeader.tsx:758-793`). Pre-17.6.0.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "the Documentation entry (top-bar Help menu -> All documentation -> /docs) is offered to every persona, and the member's rendered /docs tree equals the member's API-pruned subset with every entry opening without 401/403."
   - **Also:** step 4 should name the Help menu, and the personas' "fresh sign-up" should be "invite + sign-up" (`invite_only`).

2. **platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · acceptance[1]** (A2, rev 1). Stale clause (VF4).
   - **Why:** objectui `9eea12a2b` (objectui#10507, fixes objectui#3743, 2026-09-25) deleted `SystemHubPage.tsx` (cards and count badges). `/apps/:app/system` is now a `SystemLandingRedirect` to `/system/settings`. The file is absent at both `31971ff1e` and `2e818d0b51ec`, so the change landed before 17.6.0. The item (2026-08-30) was never updated.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "every Settings-hub entry reached from /apps/:app/system (which redirects in one hop to /system/settings) resolves to a live page."

3. **platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · acceptance[3]** (A4, rev 1). Stale clause (VF4).
   - **Why:** the same retirement deleted the hub count badges.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "retired — the hub count badges were removed with SystemHubPage (objectui#10507); drop the clause." N3 (the badge-honesty negative) goes with it.

4. **platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · acceptance[4]** (A5, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF4).
   - **Why:** this has the same root as entry 1. No `/home` sidebar exists for any persona, so "member's home nav is Home + Documentation" has no surface.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "a member's shell offers no Administration entry anywhere (no /home sidebar — HomeLayout omits it; Help menu offers Documentation); the server refusal is proven by the builtin-apps item."
   - **Also (VF4 side note):** the item's whole Administration-cluster premise (homeNavigation's `sys-administration` group) has no stable rendering surface at the pin. Revise the item as a whole: steps 1/3/5/6, A1, N1, N4.

5. **platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty · acceptance[3]** (A4, rev 1). Stale clause (VF4), by design.
   - **Why:** objectui `d524bde29` (#5557 via #5582, 2026-08-21) moved the `MarketplaceDisabled` return ahead of the `!isAdmin` guard (`MarketplacePage.tsx:206-216`; `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:558-568`, `2573ff434`). On a no-marketplace runtime every viewer gets the Disabled card. This landed before 17.6.0, and the item (since v17, rev 1) was authored against the superseded #5583 ordering.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "on a marketplace-enabled boot a non-admin gets MarketplaceAccessDenied (no spinner, no package fetch); on a features.marketplace=false boot every viewer, member included, gets the MarketplaceDisabled card — never a destructive error (objectui#5557)."
   - **Also:** negative N3 must flip with it.

6. **ai.console-ai-surface-gating · acceptance[3]** (A4, rev 1). Stale clause (VF4).
   - **Why:** objectui `9eea12a2b` (#10507, before 17.6.0) removed SystemHubPage and its "AI Approvals" card, so the K2 card half is moot. The A6 inbox half of K2 remains. The `system/ai-approvals` route is still ungated (`AppContent.tsx:207`).
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "on an agent-less boot no console surface (nav, settings hub, Home) advertises an 'AI Approvals' entry; the bare /system/ai-approvals route is scored by A6."
   - **Also:** the item's source path (`SystemHubPage.tsx`) needs updating, and N3 should name only A6.

7. **records-forms.form-view-gallery · acceptance[0]** (A1, drawer variant, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF3).
   - **Why:** objectui `RecordFormPage.tsx:281-289` says: "drawer/modal are presentation/open-modes, not record-page layouts, so they fall back to simple here (see #1890)". `resolveFormViewLayout` maps only `tabbed`. The modelling decision is ADR-0050 (Proposed): drawer/modal leave `FormView.type`, and presentation belongs to NavigationMode / `addRecord.mode` / action `type:'modal'`. Named `formViews.*` are reachable from no console door, since every consumer reads `objectDef.form ?? formViews.default`. Identical at `31971ff1e`.
   - **Corrected (derived from VF3; VF3 gave no verbatim wording):** "PER-VARIANT: each authored page-level form layout (simple / tabbed / wizard / split) renders its own layout mechanics, with a screenshot per variant; drawer and modal are presentation modes, not layouts (ADR-0050) — a drawer-presented form is proven on a surface that opens it as a side panel (e.g. a JSX ObjectForm formType="drawer"), and the metadata record-form page falling back to simple for type drawer/modal is by design (#1890); the unauthored 'modal' variant stays blocked(fixture)."
   - **Also:** steps 4–5 assume a way to open the named form views that does not exist; reach them by overlaying the default `form`. The wizard renders as steps only on the `/new` page route.

8. **records-forms.conditional-rules-grid · acceptance[4]** (A5, rev 2). Invalid pairing (VF3).
   - **Why:** on stock INV-1001 (positions 0, 1), editing one line sends only that line, and the sibling is byte-identical. The `position` re-emit happens only when sibling lines share a stored position. objectui `GridField.tsx:703-707` stamps `row[sort_field] = index`, and `masterDetailTx.ts:180-195` sends dirty fields only. INV-1002 ships one line, and a second line added through the API defaults to position 0, so the collision is created by the fixture.
   - **Corrected (derived from VF3; VF3 gave no verbatim wording):** "the saved batch persists: reloading the invoice shows the edited lines with their values, and untouched sibling lines byte-identical — on an invoice whose lines carry distinct stored positions (a sort-field normalisation of colliding positions is by design and is not a sibling rewrite)."
   - **Also:** step 3 needs a seeded second line on INV-1002 with a distinct position.

9. **records-forms.action-location-matrix · acceptance[0]** (A1, rev 6). Invalid pairing (VF4).
   - **Why:** objectui#11270 is landed in the pin (`RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx:197,456`). The showcase hosts none of the three surfaces for showcase_task:
     - `task-detail.page.ts` is `kind:'full'` with no `record:header` node, and authored pages get no injected header actions (objectui#7298 ruling).
     - `project-detail.page.ts` replaces the related strip with `record:line_items`.
     - `task.object.ts:37` `project` is the only lookup.
   - Pre-17.6.0. Owner: objectstack (showcase fixture plus item variants). Dup check: #20937 (closed, fixed by objectui#11270).
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "Per variant, every location the fixture actually HOSTS renders ≥1 action declared for it; record_header/record_more require a showcase_task page that composes a record header and record_related a parent record page that renders the synthesized Tasks related list (fixture must provide both)."
   - **Also:** A3's url / api dispatch legs share the same fixture gap.

10. **approvals.inbox-metadata-actions · acceptance[1]** (A2, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4), pre-17.6.0.
    - **Why:** `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts:568-591` `approval_recall.visible` is the submitter arm OR `record.viewer.can_override == true` (the #3424 override lever, button added by #12716). `can_override` is held by platform/tenant admins (`isOverrideActor`). `approval_remind` stays submitter-only. Clause rev 3 (2026-08-10) predates #12716. The run's approver persona was the dev admin, an override actor; VF4 notes the clause reads as invalid-pairing against such a persona.
    - **Corrected (VF4):** "send-reminder appears only on the viewer's own pending request; Recall appears on the viewer's own pending/returned request and, for an override actor (platform/tenant admin), on any pending request; a non-admin approver sees neither on another submitter's request."
    - **Also:** the personas should name a non-override approver.

11. **dashboards.global-filters-rescope · acceptance[5]** (A6, rev 2). Stale clause (VF4).
    - **Why:** `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/dashboards/ops-dashboard.dashboard.ts:87` `kpi_at_risk` (project dataset, health=red) declares `filterBindings: { task_status: false }` (#7568, project widgets opt out of the task-status filter; pinned by `dashboard-filter-vocabulary.test.ts:230`). Pre-17.6.0.
    - **Corrected (VF4):** "on Delivery Operations a widget bound to the global task_status filter that also carries its own filter (kpi_awaiting_review, status=in_review) shows the intersection, verified against the API; opted-out project tiles (kpi_at_risk) keep their unfiltered value."

---

## Conditional (only if the maintainers rule the product behaviour intended)

- **platform-core.shell-nav-personalization · acceptance[2]** (A3, rev 1) is recorded as a product defect (objectstack-ai/objectui#11626). If flat-only reorder is ruled intended, it becomes an assertion defect.
  - **Corrected (VF4):** "on an app whose navigation has no groups, drag-reorder of root items persists across reload; grouped navigation offers no reorder."

## From #21784 · surface:mixed (14 entries)

1. **access-security.readonly-package-locks-studio · acceptance[2]** (A3, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4; the lane had it as an assertion defect — the verifier's disposition wins).
   - **Why:** `POST /packages/com.example.showcase/duplicate` answers 422 `DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE`: `requireDuplicableSource` (`runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:479` ff., #14451) refuses a code-package source. Predates 17.6.0 (and 17.5.0).
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "the same PUT against an object in a writable base package (created via POST /api/v1/packages — not duplicate, which refuses code sources per #14451) succeeds for the same admin and a follow-up GET shows the change."
   - **Also (FE7):** step 5 prescribes the same duplicate route; A2's code set should add `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (bare `PUT`; `ITEM_LOCKED` only with `?package=`).

2. **access-security.audit-log-browser · acceptance[0]** (A1, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4), **after** 17.6.0.
   - **Why:** `7ebb543164` (#21296, fixes #21260, 2026-10-02) gives platform admins `view_all_audit_log` by default (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`), exempting them from the ledger's parent-record gate, so the admin's read serves the delete row. Rev 3 was measured on 17.6.0 and encodes only #21194.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "...delete -> action 'delete' (showcase_task + record_id) is served to a reader holding view_all_audit_log (platform admins by default, #21296) and withheld from a non-holder who cannot read the deleted record (#21194)."

3. **access-security.audit-log-browser · acceptance[4]** (A5, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4), same cause.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "API and page agree row-for-row for the same principal (admin: login, config_change and delete)."
   - **Also (FE7):** rev 2's "there is no Action dropdown" is false at this console pin.

4. **identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · acceptance[9]** (A10, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4), delete-user half only.
   - **Why:** `plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts:148-157` books `POST /api/v1/auth/delete-user` disposition `disabled` (`user.deleteUser` deliberately unconfigured, `auth-manager.ts:1561`), maintainer ruling 2026-08-12 (#7735). The clause (rev 1, 2026-08-07) predates the ruling.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "POST /auth/change-email succeeds for the signed-in user and answers 401 to the anonymous forge; POST /auth/delete-user is deliberately unwired (ledger disposition 'disabled') and answers 404 to every caller, authed or not."

5. **identity-auth.workspace-org-switch · acceptance[5]** (A6, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF4). Fails closed, not authorization class.
   - **Why:** better-auth 1.7.3 `plugins/organization/routes/crud-org.mjs` setActiveOrganization calls `adapter.setActiveOrganization(token, null)` before throwing 403; plugin-auth mounts the route unwrapped (`auth-route-ledger.ts:274` 'sdk'). The active org becomes none, never the foreign org.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "set-active to a non-membership org answers 403 USER_IS_NOT_A_MEMBER_OF_THE_ORGANIZATION, the foreign org never becomes active (get-active-member returns the prior org or none — better-auth clears the active org on refusal), and the UI surfaces an error."
   - **Optional follow-up (VF4):** wrap the vendor call if keeping the previous org is required; then it becomes a product enhancement.

6. **records-forms.cascading-options · acceptance[2]** (A3, rev 2). Invalid pairing (VF4).
   - **Why:** the fixture predicate is `'org_admin' in current_user.positions` (`cascading-select.object.ts:100`); `mapMembershipRole` (`spec identity/eval-user.zod.ts:201-205`) maps owner → `org_owner` with no implication of `org_admin`, so the seeded admin (`org_owner`) is outside the gate. Predicate landed before 17.6.0.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "BOTH sides of the role gate: a persona holding org_admin (a member invited with role 'admin') sees and persists tier='restricted'; a plain member neither sees nor can submit it (server invalid_option)."
   - **Alternative (VF4):** fix the fixture predicate to `['org_owner','org_admin'].exists(r, r in current_user.positions)` (an "admin only" option the owner cannot pick is arguably a P3 fixture defect). Persona note: an `admin` invitation needs `accept-invitation` to grant `org_admin`.

7. **records-forms.field-group-visible-when · acceptance[0]** (A1, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF4).
   - **Why:** the spec normalizes a bare string to `{dialect:'cel',source}` (`shared/expression.zod.ts:184-187`, pinned by `object-strictness-batch20.test.ts:477-489`), but runtime-authored metadata is persisted verbatim and served unparsed (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:1344,1652`, ADR-0005 appendix (c)). Pre-17.6.0.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "authoring accepts both the bare CEL string and the {dialect:'cel',source} envelope on fieldGroups[].visibleWhen; the schema parse normalizes the string to the envelope (batch20 pin), the meta API serves the body as authored, and either form gates the group identically at render."
   - **Also (FE12):** the knownGaps and A4's text ("both adapters drop it") are out of date — both copy `visibleWhen` at the pin, the form gates live; only the detail page still fails (product defect `objectstack-ai/objectui#11630`, not parked).

8. **automation.flow-run-step-nesting · acceptance[1]** (A2, rev 4). Stale clause (VF4).
   - **Why:** `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts:910-926` wraps `send_reminder` in the try_catch `guard_reminder` (#13681 / #14394, present before 17.6.0); the engine's innermost-identity rule (`service-automation engine.ts:11596-11625`, #15230) tags the body step with the try region.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "each of the three guard_reminder steps carries {parentNodeId:'loop_tasks', regionKind:'loop-body', iteration 0|1|2}, each send_reminder carries {parentNodeId:'guard_reminder', regionKind:'try'} with the same iteration, no two share an iteration; start/loop_tasks/end carry no parentNodeId."

9. **automation.rollup-summary-filter · acceptance[4]** (A5, rev 3). Stale clause (VF4).
   - **Why:** duplicate of the code showcase package is refused `DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE` (#14451). The editor half was proven on a scratch writable package.
   - **Corrected (VF4):** "the child-row filter is settable in Studio's visual filter editor on a writable base package (create a scratch base via POST /api/v1/packages and author the parent+summary there, or overlay per ADR-0005), and persists per the meta API; duplicate of the code showcase package is refused DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE (#14451)."

10. **automation.flow-node-type-matrix · acceptance[0]** (A1, rev 3). Assertion defect (VF4).
    - **Why:** `spec automation/flow.zod.ts:72` `FLOW_STRUCTURAL_NODE_TYPES = ['start','end']` — no executor, no descriptor, so not in `GET /automation/actions`.
    - **Corrected (VF4):** "the palette feed offers every NON-structural variant (19 of 21; start/end are structural per FLOW_STRUCTURAL_NODE_TYPES)".

11. **automation.flow-node-type-matrix · acceptance[1]** (A2, rev 3). Assertion defect (VF4).
    - **Why:** `executeNode` returns on `end` before any step push (`engine.ts:10897-10925`); `start` logs a success step (`:10972-10980`).
    - **Corrected (VF4):** "each non-structural variant plus `start` appears as an executed step; `end` is proven by the run reaching status completed (it logs no step)."
    - **Also (FE13):** `showcase_fan_out_notify` needs Slack egress; prove parallel / http on another run where egress is denied.

12. **automation.trigger-type-matrix · acceptance[0]** (A1, rev 1). Assertion defect (VF4).
    - **Why:** `engine.ts:1175-1190` `buildRunTrigger` sets `trigger.type = context.event ?? 'manual'` — the launch event, not `Flow.type` (`execution.zod.ts:376` describes a free string). Pre-17.6.0 (#7533).
    - **Corrected (VF4):** "per-variant: each trigger kind produces a run row of its bound flow (flowName identifies the kind via the flow's declared type); trigger.type records the launch event (record_change runs also carry object + recordId); all six individually verified."

13. **platform-core.app-management-toggle · acceptance[5]** (A6, rev 1). Stale clause (VF5).
    - **Why:** objectui `3b7d1cc6d7` (#4233 / #4300, 2026-08-11) wired AppManagementPage to real `saveItem` / `deleteItem`, before the 17.6.0 console pin, so the "client-only stub" clause was already stale at 17.6.0.
    - **Corrected (VF5):** "AppManagementPage writes through PUT/DELETE /api/v1/meta/app/{name}: on a code-package app Disable/Set-default return 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE with an error toast and /meta/app is unchanged on reload; Delete returns 200 reset:false (a no-op) and the page must not report the app as deleted."
    - **Note:** the "must not report the app as deleted" half is the open candidate (Delete toasts "deleted" for a `reset:false` no-op, VF5, unverified live) — expect it to fail once the clause is re-pointed.

14. **platform-core.app-management-toggle · negative[0]** (N1, rev 1). Stale clause (VF5), same cause.
    - **Corrected (derived from VF5):** "no control on AppManagementPage reports success for a write the server refused: a 403 on a code-package app surfaces as an error toast and leaves /meta/app unchanged; a writable app's toggle takes real effect."
    - **Also (FE15):** the item's knownGap describing the stub should be rewritten to the wired contract.

---

Not parked (wording issues attached to a product-defect fail, recorded in the record's checklist-accuracy findings): `identity-auth.email-verification-loop` acceptance[2] names a POST variant that does not exist (the mailed link is the API GET) — corrected (derived from VF1): "following the mailed verification link (GET /api/v1/auth/verify-email?token=…) verifies the account, and the console's /verify-email page, given a valid token, reports success". `integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui` fixture says `columnCount` 5; it is 7.
